comments.author: DBravo
comments.body: This is a level 3 tech. It requires R8 Search & R5 Archeology, as well as level 2 tech Improved Pit Trap. I learned it in Bordeaux dungeon middle floor.

comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
After the release with chapter 3 of Atlantis (Acropolis), the conditions for obtaining this tech is now:

Trap rank 5
Archaeology rank 5
Improved Pit Trap

Note: one of the NPC in FSD punishment room uses this tech.

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: I learned this tech in the punishment room (that's the big empty space with a bunch of often high level NPCs that can be en-counted in the hidden passages) in FSD mid. To get them to use it, try provoking one of the enemies with a power, quick, or feint tech with the Outlaw Graverobber Lv62 (the ones with axes) in front of you. This will cause them to unleash their battle techs on you, but it has a high chance of the Violent Voyager Lv60 NPC (they use throwing knives) of using this tech on you. Be careful as they can use this multiple times on you, causing you to get trapped and be killed. If your not a high enough level, try getting another player to assist you with this.
